sseilQuestions.text: What is the standard retail greeting protocol upon customer entry?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Within 30 seconds with smile","After 5 minutes","Wait for customer to ask","Ignore"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Within 30 seconds with smile

sseilQuestions.text: How should inventory shrinkage variances above 2% be escalated?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Log incident and notify Store Supervisor","Hide in back room","Write off immediately","No action"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Log incident and notify Store Supervisor

sseilQuestions.text: What is the mandatory customer greeting timeframe upon store entry?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Within 30 seconds with courteous eye contact","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Within 30 seconds with courteous eye contact

sseilQuestions.text: Which document must be validated prior to initiating a high-value exchange?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Original retail invoice or authenticated digital receipt","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Original retail invoice or authenticated digital receipt

sseilQuestions.text: Under the morning opening checklist, when must POS terminals be powered on?
sseilQuestions.options: ["At least 15 minutes prior to official trading hours","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: At least 15 minutes prior to official trading hours

sseilQuestions.text: What is the immediate escalation procedure for POS pricing discrepancy variances?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Halt checkout line, notify store supervisor, and verify barcode master","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Halt checkout line, notify store supervisor, and verify barcode master

sseilQuestions.text: Which cycle count inventory variance threshold triggers mandatory supervisor sign-off?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Any discrepancy exceeding 2% or INR 1,000 in unit value","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Any discrepancy exceeding 2% or INR 1,000 in unit value

sseilQuestions.text: What is the standard protocol when a customer payment terminal displays Pending Auth?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Do not re-swipe card; verify merchant acquirer status slip first","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Do not re-swipe card; verify merchant acquirer status slip first

sseilQuestions.text: Which personal grooming standard is non-negotiable for retail floor brand advisors?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Clean company uniform with standard display name badge","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Clean company uniform with standard display name badge

sseilQuestions.text: How should outdated promotional visual merchandising collateral be dispositioned?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Dismantle immediately and log return/destruction with brand audit","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Dismantle immediately and log return/destruction with brand audit

sseilQuestions.text: What is the maximum cash threshold permitted in an active till prior to safe drop?
sseilQuestions.options: ["INR 15,000 threshold or end-of-shift cash pull","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: INR 15,000 threshold or end-of-shift cash pull

sseilQuestions.text: In a suspected shoplifting situation, which action is strictly prohibited by retail staff?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Physical restraint or public customer accusation on the sales floor","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Physical restraint or public customer accusation on the sales floor

sseilQuestions.text: What is the mandatory verification step for direct store delivery (DSD) intake?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Count cartons against vendor manifest before driver departure","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Count cartons against vendor manifest before driver departure

sseilQuestions.text: What secondary evacuation protocol applies if the primary emergency egress is blocked?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Direct floor occupants to secondary marked back-exit assembly point","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Direct floor occupants to secondary marked back-exit assembly point

sseilQuestions.text: How frequently must interactive customer demo units be sanitized during operations?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Every 2 hours and immediately following intensive customer trial","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Every 2 hours and immediately following intensive customer trial

sseilQuestions.text: What is the minimum advance notice required for submitting a weekend shift swap?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Minimum 48 hours notice with supervisor confirmation","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Minimum 48 hours notice with supervisor confirmation

sseilQuestions.text: Which verification item is required before issuing a replacement loyalty gift card?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Registered customer mobile number with OTP confirmation","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Registered customer mobile number with OTP confirmation

sseilQuestions.text: What is the primary objective of the 3-step consultative selling model?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Understand customer lifestyle needs before recommending tailored solutions","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Understand customer lifestyle needs before recommending tailored solutions

sseilQuestions.text: Who is required to witness and sign off the final register drawer reconciliation?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Cashier associate and closing store supervisor together","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Cashier associate and closing store supervisor together

sseilQuestions.text: What protocol governs the storage of floor cleaning and maintenance chemicals?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Store in locked, ventilated janitorial closet away from retail merchandise","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Store in locked, ventilated janitorial closet away from retail merchandise

sseilQuestions.text: How must physical customer feedback forms with personal contact details be secured?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Deposit into locked drop-box and archive in compliance with privacy policy","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Deposit into locked drop-box and archive in compliance with privacy policy

sseilQuestions.text: What is the mandatory reporting window for customer or staff slip-and-fall incidents?
sseilQuestions.options: ["Immediate first aid and incident log entry within 30 minutes","Alternate Procedure B","Non-Compliant Deviation C","Discretionary Decision D"]
sseilQuestions.correct_answer: Immediate first aid and incident log entry within 30 minutes
